svg.title: Breaking Into Device Sales
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-breaking-into-device-sales; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Breaking Into Device Sales; subtitle: A referral-first sprint from profile cleanup to a capital pipeline; caption: Valente says almost all roles come from referrals and fewer than 1% of applicants break in; Licata's capital funnel runs 30 accounts for 1 to 2 purchase orders.; assumptions note: The four-week sequencing organizes the practitioners' tactics; the speakers did not prescribe a calendar.; note: Attributed to Vincent Valente (Break Into Medical Device Sales), Jacob (New to Medical Device Sales), Med Sales With Matt, and Joe Licata.; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Clean up the profile; deliverable: Open to work badge removed and AI dashes stripped from outreach text; gate: Hiring managers no longer read desperation into the profile; week: Week 2; title: Work the referral web; deliverable: No-note LinkedIn requests and sub-100-word messages to reps; gate: Referral conversations booked, held to a 70/30 listening ratio; week: Week 3; title: Run the interview gauntlet; deliverable: Prepared for 4 to 8 rounds against 200 to 400 applicants per role; gate: Interview even if relocating; multiple offers trigger bidding wars; week: Week 4; title: Map the capital pipeline; deliverable: 30 accounts targeted for 1 to 2 purchase orders over 1 to 5 years; gate: Never inflate pipeline progress reported to managers
